Whale recordings from NOAA Fisheries' Passive Acoustics Group ("Sounds in the Ocean: marine
mammals", https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/national/science-data/sounds-ocean-mammals). Works of the
U.S. federal government, in the public domain in the United States (17 U.S.C. 105). Converted to
44.1 kHz mono Ogg Vorbis, otherwise unchanged. Processed into Level 490's whale song by
tools/level_assets/level490_sounds.py.

humpback_song.ogg          Meno-song-NOAA-PAGroup-13-humpback-clip.mp3 (humpback whale song)
right_whale_upcall.ogg     Eugl-upcall-NOAA-PAGroup-01-right-clip-1.mp3 (North Atlantic right whale up-calls)
sei_whale_downsweep.ogg    Babo-downsweep-NOAA-PAGroup-06-x2speed-sei-whale-clip.mp3 (sei whale downsweeps, at twice their real speed)
